clue.text: System of writing verses

explanation.surface: A method for composing poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: A metric is a system of measurement, and metric verse is poetry composed in regular metre.

clue.text: Pithy phrase promoted non-dairy spread, very good for digestion

indicators.note: the spread takes the other piece into its middle as if eating it
in a down clue, promoted means the word is moved upwards, so read from bottom to top

parts.note: marge is short for margarine, a butter substitute
pi is slang for pious, very good

explanation.surface: Margarine, marketed as healthy for the stomach, gets a catchy slogan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promoted' turns MARGE into EGRAM, and 'for digestion' has that swallow PI.
explanation.definitionFit: An epigram is a short witty saying, a terse remark.

clue.text: Big bird seen in Leatherhead

indicators.note: the bird is visible inside the letters of the town name

explanation.surface: A large bird spotted in a Surrey town.
explanation.walkthrough: Leatherhead is a town in Surrey, England.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhea is a large flightless South American ratite.

clue.text: Party game prince left out for a duchess

indicators.note: one letter goes out and something else replaces it

parts.note: Charles was long the best-known British prince
D is an abbreviation for duchess

explanation.surface: A royal skips a party to visit a duchess instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out for' swaps L in CHARLES for A and D.
explanation.definitionFit: Charades is a parlour game of miming words for others to guess.

clue.text: Small government department established

parts.note: MOD is the UK Ministry of Defence

explanation.surface: A minor ministry is set up.
explanation.definitionFit: Modest means humble or slight in size, little.

clue.text: Baleful maiden put on dress

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece is placed on top of the other

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
to dress ranks is to align troops in straight lines

explanation.surface: A gloomy girl gets dressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Malign means evil or harmful in influence, a synonym.

clue.text: Hopeless rep teased dreadfully

indicators.note: done dreadfully, the letters of these two words are mangled into new order

explanation.surface: A salesman was mocked terribly and is in despair.
explanation.definitionFit: Desperate describes a situation beyond hope, dire.

clue.text: Distorted representation of railway town in South Dakota

indicators.note: the town sits inside the state's letters

parts.note: SD is the postal abbreviation for South Dakota
Crewe in Cheshire is a famous railway junction town

explanation.surface: A muddled picture of a rail town placed in the American Midwest.
explanation.definitionFit: Screwed can mean twisted or warped out of shape.

clue.text: Women left to ring one in new health executive

indicators.note: the numeral goes inside the rearranged word
new signals the word health in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Women are asked to phone a newly appointed health boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns HEALTH into an arrangement that, with I put 'in', gives HITEHAL; 'to ring' joins the L on.
explanation.definitionFit: Whitehall is the London street of ministries, used to mean the UK civil service and government.

clue.text: Spell disaster?

parts.note: read as a magician's mishap: an excellent crash in old RAF slang, or a calamity with a spell

explanation.definitionFit: Wizard prang is old RAF slang for a spectacular crash, and a wizard casts spells.

clue.text: Typically, elder journalist needed about an hour

indicators.note: the journalist goes around the hour

parts.note: a sub is a subeditor on a newspaper
HR is the abbreviation for hour

explanation.surface: An aging reporter required an hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elder' looks like an older person, but it is the elderberry bush; 'Typically' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The elder is one example of a woody bush.

clue.text: Most junior director seen through rear window?

definitions.text: Most junior director seen through rear window?

parts.words: Most junior director seen through rear window?
parts.note: a newest boardroom member, and the infant sticker displayed in the back of a car

explanation.definitionFit: A baby is the youngest, and on the board is where directors sit; the sign hangs in car rear windows.

clue.text: Nothing about entering Australia, on reflection

indicators.note: as in a mirror, the whole is read backwards
the word for about goes inside the nickname

parts.note: Oz is a nickname for Australia
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Nothing about going into Australia, when you think it over.
explanation.definitionFit: Zero is nought, the figure for none.

clue.text: Gent bawled out -result of practising deceit?

indicators.note: bawled out suggests a scolding, but out here means the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A man shouted down: the upshot of lying.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation 'Oh what a tangled web we weave, when first we practise to deceive' is from Scott's Marmion.
explanation.definitionFit: Lies proverbially weave a complicated mesh that traps the liar.

clue.text: Recall person in sapper unit?

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, whose soldiers are called sappers
a member is a person belonging to a group

explanation.surface: A soldier in the Royal Engineers is called back.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as RE-MEMBER, one who belongs to the Royal Engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall is to bring back to mind, a synonym.

clue.text: Border history presented in parade

parts.note: a march is a border region, as in the Welsh Marches
history is the past

explanation.surface: Borderland history shown in a procession.
explanation.definitionFit: A march past is a ceremonial parade of troops before a dignitary.

clue.text: Sound when girl appears in gold ring

indicators.note: the girl's name is placed inside the gold ring

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
O is ring-shaped
Di is a short girl's name

explanation.surface: A noise as a girl shows up wearing a golden ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Audio means relating to recorded or transmitted sound.

clue.text: Warm room, such as you'll find all over the country

definitions.text: such as you'll find all over the country

parts.note: to air clothes is to warm them
room means space

explanation.surface: Heated spaces exist everywhere across the land.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition describes the sky above a nation, which covers the whole territory.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation's controlled sky extends over its entire land area.

clue.text: First signs of penguins on leaving Argentine Republic for Antarctic

indicators.note: the opening letter of each following word is picked

explanation.surface: Penguins depart Argentina to head south.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar means near the pole, and Antarctica surrounds the South Pole.

clue.text: Permit excessive liberty

explanation.surface: Permission becomes overindulgence.
explanation.definitionFit: A licence is official permission, and also disregard for rules, abuse of freedom.

clue.text: Trouble stored up by enemy mine?

parts.note: time is often called the enemy, as in time the old enemy
a mine is an explosive, a bomb

explanation.surface: Danger lies ahead from a hostile explosive.
explanation.definitionFit: A figurative fuse is a problem that will erupt later.

clue.text: In French department, cricket team ultimately appeared to get rusty

indicators.note: the opening word puts the following pieces inside the department

parts.note: Oise is a department north of Paris
a cricket side is an eleven, XI

indicators.note: ultimately points at the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Cricketers in France seemed to be out of practice.
explanation.definitionFit: To oxidise is to combine with oxygen, as iron does when it corrodes.

clue.text: Run round a bay, being initially unfit

indicators.note: the running word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: to fly is to run away, flee

indicators.note: takes the first letter of each word

explanation.surface: Jogging around a bay when out of shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Flabby means slack and soft in muscle, out of condition.

clue.text: Problem involving an inordinate number of units?

definitions.text: Problem involving an inordinate number of units?

parts.words: Problem involving an inordinate number of units?
parts.note: looks like a maths puzzle, but the units are measures of drink

explanation.definitionFit: Units measure drink consumption; drinking too many habitually is a dependency.

clue.text: Flying bomb has absolute endorsement

parts.note: the V1 was the German flying bomb of WWII
's is a contraction of has
A stood for absolute, as in degrees A on the old absolute temperature scale

explanation.surface: A doodlebug gets complete approval.
explanation.definitionFit: A visa is an endorsement stamped in a passport permitting entry.

clue.text: Exotic vegetable raised in Sark once

indicators.note: raised says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A foreign vegetable grown on Sark in the past.
explanation.walkthrough: Sark is one of the Channel Islands; in a down clue 'raised' reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is the pods of a tropical plant, ladies' fingers.

clue.text: Dope setting article on New Jersey in Georgia

indicators.note: the pieces are put inside the Georgia letters

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for Georgia
a is the indefinite article
NJ is the postal abbreviation for New Jersey

explanation.surface: Drugs travel from New Jersey to Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: Ganja is cannabis, and dope is slang for that drug.

clue.text: Boycott's given umpire a pie filling

parts.note: to black goods is to boycott them, a trade-union term
Dickie Bird was a famous English cricket umpire

explanation.surface: Geoffrey Boycott, the Yorkshire batsman, hands the umpire a pie.
explanation.walkthrough: The nursery rhyme has four and twenty blackbirds baked in a pie.
explanation.definitionFit: In the rhyme Sing a Song of Sixpence, birds are baked into a pie.

clue.text: Well-bred people hear information first

indicators.note: says the information piece comes before the other

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
a judge hears a case, that is tries it

explanation.surface: Upper-class folk listen to the facts before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentry are the class of people of good birth just below nobility.

clue.text: Shiny coat fellow in shelter returned

indicators.note: the combined piece is read backwards
the fellow goes inside the shelter

parts.note: lee is shelter from wind
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: A man in a refuge came back with a glossy jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: Enamel is a glossy paint or glaze coating.
